title: Reproducing 'High-Reward = Sycophantic' Labeler-Bias Predictor on an Open Preference Set

original_idea.body: Whether sycophancy-reward share in a public preference set predicts policy sycophancy.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a data-level metric that forecasts sycophancy before training lets anyone audit preference data.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: off-the-shelf RM scoring on a public set + light policy alignment.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: sycophancy-reward share predicting policy sycophancy; mild light-alignment dependency.

novelty.reasoning: Recent paper makes the claim; independent check on a public set may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent paper makes the claim; independent verification on a public preference set is a likely-open follow-up.
